direct_crosschecks_this_ingest.result: CONFIRMED two-step task confirmation, call_id-scoped pending function calls, cancelled-response discard, direct memory dispatch, and capsule refresh without capsule serialization in response instructions
CONFIRMED delegated claude -p uses permission mode with Bash hard-disallowed while Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob remain available; this is defense-in-depth, not typed per-effect authority
TWO SOURCE-IDENTITY CHECKS AGREE on historical wache-koenig/freigabe hashes and Bash-scoped one-shot pre-dispatch semantics; neither promotes current host reachability

forensic_findings.claim: Realtime frank_auftrag_stellen has a real mechanical human-intent precursor: first call proposes, second call must match normalized task text, request bestaetigt=true, follow at least one new server-originated audio transcription, avoid explicit contradiction and remain within 300 seconds. This admits a high-level task request only. It does not bind or pre-authorize the concrete downstream Write/Edit or other state-changing calls performed by the delegated Claude process.
forensic_findings.migration: Keep the voice confirmation primitive, but mint a typed TaskAdmission bound to immutable invocation/task digest and require each downstream state-changing effect to obtain and atomically consume its own EffectDecision.

forensic_findings.claim: Realtime buffers model function calls by call_id and discards them when a response completes with non-completed/cancelled status or barge-in clears the pending map. This is a strong pre-dispatch identity/cancellation donor, but call_id is not carried through the current delegated Claude sub-effects or stern effect journal.
forensic_findings.migration: Retain call_id as outer VoiceInvocation identity and derive/bind child TaskAdmission and per-effect invocation identities without conflating pre-dispatch cancellation with post-submission effect outcome.

forensic_findings.claim: frank_erinnerung_schreiben directly persists model-selected conversation memory through stern's narrow conversation-memory writer without the task two-step gate. The bounded table scope reduces blast radius, but persistence does not prove factual truth and currently lacks the same explicit typed epistemic/admission boundary demanded by EntityOS authority law.
forensic_findings.migration: Introduce MemoryCandidate -> MemoryAdmission with source/causal/provenance/privacy/type fields; remembered quote, user claim, model summary, inference and verified observation remain distinguishable. MemoryAdmission is not EffectDecision and cannot mint world fact authority.

forensic_findings.claim: The voice bridge delegates confirmed tasks to claude -p asynchronously. Bash is hard-disallowed, but file mutation tools remain available. Source inspection does not establish one executor-consumed typed decision for every downstream mutation, so high-level user confirmation plus Bash denial must not be reported as complete EffectGate coverage.
forensic_findings.migration: Place deterministic per-effect enforcement below modality/task delegation. Front-gates may differ by modality, but final effect authority must converge.

forensic_findings.claim: The schema-valid successor packet and an independent direct-source crosscheck agree that archived wache-koenig/freigabe implement Bash-scoped pre-dispatch blocking plus exact-command hash, expiry and one-shot ticket consumption. These are reusable enforcement principles, not current runtime proof and not non-Bash coverage.
forensic_findings.migration: Reuse pre-dispatch deny, separately minted grant, request binding, expiry and one-shot consumption; replace command-regex/raw-command identity with typed capability/resource/invocation/generation/policy identity.

forensic_findings.claim: wegehierarchie source bytes are recoverable under _archiv-phase4, while the live paket.py relative import still targets .wegehierarchie. The problem is therefore executable package closure/retirement intent, not total source loss.
forensic_findings.migration: Triggerword 4 must either adapt the archived logic into an explicit tested successor or retire the caller branch with a regression proving no silent degradation.

non_implication_rules: MemoryAdmission does not imply factual truth
EffectDecision does not imply successful submission
SubmissionReceipt does not imply known outcome
Execution success cannot retroactively create admission authority
cancelled before local dispatch is not equivalent to cancelled after submission
frankenstein2_authority_model_delta.memory_admission_rule: Conversation memory remains typed remembered evidence/candidate with provenance and privacy policy; it cannot silently become canonical world fact or a capability grant.
frankenstein2_authority_model_delta.executor_rule: Every non-exempt state-changing effect must atomically consume exactly one matching EffectDecision at the actual execution boundary. Task-level approval, model tool choice, Bash denial, hook journaling and post-hoc success are insufficient substitutes.
frankenstein2_authority_model_delta.cancellation_rule: Realtime call cancellation may prove PRE_DISPATCH_CANCELLED only while the call is still buffered. Once a downstream task/effect is submitted, outcome transitions through SUBMITTED -> VERIFIED_SUCCESS/VERIFIED_FAILURE/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and is never blindly replayed.

contradictions.detail: Realtime task confirmation is real but high-level; exact per-effect authorization across delegated mutations is not source-proven.
Model-selected conversation memory can become durable immediately; the table is narrow, but epistemic type/provenance/admission must be explicit so memory cannot become fact by persistence.

The current two-step voice gate has no speaker verification/full intent classifier; source itself admits unrelated second-speaker speech can satisfy the freshness condition if model interpretation and keyword veto align.
Historical source identity is now multiply corroborated, but current/historical scheduler registration, ordering and live reachability remain unproven.

required_design_changes: Compile voice confirmation into TaskAdmission, never blanket downstream effect permission.
Bind Realtime call_id/outer invocation identity through task and child effect lineage.
Classify every Realtime tool as READ_ONLY, EPHEMERAL_STATE, CANONICAL_INTERNAL_MUTATION, EXTERNAL_EFFECT_REQUEST or SESSION_CONTROL.
Add deterministic MemoryAdmission and preserve remembered-claim versus verified-fact distinction.
Require one-shot per-effect EffectDecision consumption at the actual executor across Bash and non-Bash mutations.
required_regressions: same voice task text with wrong call_id/task digest is rejected
valid TaskAdmission cannot authorize an unbound child mutation
cancelled Realtime response cannot dispatch buffered function calls
post-submission transport loss produces OUTCOME_UNKNOWN not CANCELLED
memory entry remains typed remembered evidence and cannot satisfy a verified-fact predicate by persistence alone
parallel voice tasks cannot cross-assign shared Claude-session effects/results
Write/Edit and other non-Bash mutations traverse deterministic effect authority

next_exact_gate: Trace the exact host/plugin enforcement loaded by gespraechsmodus.claude_frage and every mutating Realtime tool, then feed Triggerword 4 a tested TaskAdmission -> child EffectRequest -> one-shot EffectDecision executor contract; separately trace conversation-memory read paths to prove remembered evidence never becomes world fact by retrieval.
